 "data": "flowchart TD

%% =========================
%% v1.1 CORRECTION NOTE
%% Prior versions wired the Session Logs Tool as a capability of the Admin
%% Portal (ADMINSVC --> LOGTOOL). This was wrong: confirmed by live testing
%% against the real Admin Portal API that it returns session metadata
%% (status, timeline, auditor decision, docs/QnA) only — NO backend
%% application/infrastructure logs. Backend logs live on the platform's own
%% server infrastructure and are exposed to this system exclusively through
%% a separate Multi-Tenant Log Platform (see LogPlatform subgraph below).
%% See SUPPORT_OPERATIONS_BLUEPRINT.md §9/§34/§35 for the full corrected
%% process and the mandatory PII-redaction + relevance-extraction stage
%% this correction also introduces (LOGEXTRACT below).
%% =========================

%% =========================
%% EXTERNAL SYSTEMS
%% =========================
subgraph External [External Interfaces]
 USER[Bank Agent / Customer]
 FD[Freshdesk]
 ASANA[Asana]
 DEV[Engineering Team]
end

%% =========================
%% CORE INGESTION & ROUTING
%% =========================
subgraph Core [Ingestion & Case Management]
 TICKET[Ticket Ingestion Service]
 CASE[Case Service]
 CASEDB[(Cases DB)]
end

%% =========================
%% TENANT RESOLUTION
%% =========================
subgraph Tenant [Multi-Tenant Resolution]
 CLIENTRESOLVE[Client Resolution Engine]
 TENANTREG[(Tenant Registry)]
 TENANTCTX[Tenant Context]
end

%% =========================
%% AI & ORCHESTRATION
%% =========================
subgraph AI [AI & Reasoning Engine]
 NLP[LLM Semantic Router NLP Layer]
 CLASSIFIER[Topic Classification]
 SLOTEXTRACT[Slot Extraction]
 CLARIFICATION[Clarification Engine]
 WORKFLOWSELECT[Workflow Selection]
 ENGINE[Workflow Engine]
 INVESTIGATION[Investigation Planner]
 EVIDENCE[Evidence Collector]
 ROOTCAUSE[Root Cause Engine]
 REASONING[Reasoning Engine]
 GUARDRAILS[Policy & Safety Guardrails]
 OBSGEN[Observation Generator]
 LLM((OpenAI LLM API))
end

%% =========================
%% KNOWLEDGE LAYER
%% =========================
subgraph Knowledge [Knowledge Layer]
 STACK[(StackOverflow Teams Export)]
 INGEST[Knowledge Ingestion]
 INDEX[Knowledge Indexer]
 HYBRIDRAG[Hybrid RAG]
 VISION[Image Understanding]
 PLAYBOOKS[(Workflow Playbooks)]
 ONTOLOGY[(Intent & Slot Ontology)]
end

%% =========================
%% ADMIN PORTAL LAYER (session metadata ONLY — no backend logs)
%% Renamed from \"Unity Bank Admin APIs\" — this is a multi-tenant capability,
%% Unity is the first (and so far only fully live) tenant, not the ceiling.
%% =========================
subgraph AdminPortal [Multi-Tenant Admin Portal APIs - session metadata only, NO backend logs]
 ADMINPORTAL[Admin Portal APIs per tenant]
 ADMINSVC[Client Support APIs]
 USERTOOL[GetUserDetails]
 SESSIONTOOL[GetSessionDetails]
 FAILTOOL[GetFailureReason]
 CASETOOL[GetCaseHistory]
 ONBOARDTOOL[GetOnboardingStatus]
 SUMMARYTOOL[Session Summary Tool]
end

%% =========================
%% MULTI-TENANT LOG PLATFORM (Grafana Loki) — backend logs live here, NOT
%% on the Admin Portal. Independent credentials, independent base URL,
%% independent datasource per tenant. Queried using the time window that
%% GetSessionDetails (Admin Portal) already returned - see LOGTOOL edges
%% below. See SUPPORT_OPERATIONS_BLUEPRINT.md §34 for the full model.
%% =========================
subgraph LogPlatform [Multi-Tenant Log Platform - Grafana Loki - backend/infra logs]
 LOKIREG[(Per-Tenant Log Datasource Registry: base_url + datasource id + credentials)]
 LOKIAPI[Direct Log Platform API - cross-service sweep per session window]
end

%% =========================
%% TOOL & INVESTIGATION LAYER
%% =========================
subgraph Tools [Tool Registry & Investigation APIs]
 TOOLS[Tool Registry]
 TENANTROUTER[Tenant API Router]
 LOGTOOL[Session Logs Tool - GetSessionLogsTool]
 LOGEXTRACT[Log Relevance Extractor - PII Redaction + BM25 Ranking + Dedup]
 VIDEOTOOL[Session Video Tool]
 METRICTOOL[Metrics Tool]
 SERVERTOOL[Server Status Tool]
end

%% =========================
%% EXECUTION LAYER (Reserved for Future Use — not connected to L1 pipeline)
%% No L1 playbook routes here. Action Gateway is in codebase but inactive.
%% =========================
subgraph Execution [Action & Resolution Layer - Reserved for Future Use]
 ACTIONPROPOSAL[Action Proposal]
 ACTIONGW[Action Gateway]
 RISKCHECK{Risk Level}
 APPROVAL[Approval Workflow]
 HUMANAPPROVER[Human Approver]
 EXECUTE[Executor]
 ACTIONDB[(Actions DB)]
 VERIFY[Verification Engine]
 RECOVERY[Recovery Service]
 RESOLUTION[Automated Resolution]
 NOTEGEN[Notes Generator]
 USERRESPONSE[Generate Customer Reply]
 CLOSE[Close Ticket]
 ESCALATE[Escalate to Human Agent]
 FDUPDATE_ESC[Update cf_asana_ticket_link]
end

%% =========================
%% GOVERNANCE
%% =========================
subgraph Governance [Audit & Compliance]
 AUDIT[Audit Service]
 AUDITDB[(Audit Events DB)]
end

%% =========================
%% KNOWLEDGE INGESTION
%% =========================
STACK --> INGEST
INGEST --> INDEX
INDEX --> HYBRIDRAG
VISION --> HYBRIDRAG

%% =========================
%% USER FLOW
%% =========================
USER -->|Email Support| FD
FD --> TICKET
TICKET --> CLIENTRESOLVE
CLIENTRESOLVE --> TENANTREG
CLIENTRESOLVE --> TENANTCTX
TENANTCTX --> CASE
CASE --> CASEDB

%% =========================
%% AI FLOW (NLP FIRST)
%% =========================
CASE --> NLP
NLP --> LLM
NLP --> ONTOLOGY
NLP --> CLASSIFIER
NLP --> SLOTEXTRACT

CLASSIFIER --> SLOTEXTRACT
SLOTEXTRACT --> DECISION1{All Investigation Slots Present?}

%% =========================
%% CLARIFICATION LOOP (ASK FOR URN/SESSION ID)
%% =========================
DECISION1 -->|No| CLARIFICATION
CLARIFICATION --> LLM
CLARIFICATION --> OUTBOUND[Reply Generator]
OUTBOUND --> FD
FD --> USER

%% =========================
%% WORKFLOW ORCHESTRATION
%% =========================
DECISION1 -->|Yes| WORKFLOWSELECT
WORKFLOWSELECT --> ENGINE
ENGINE --> PLAYBOOKS
PLAYBOOKS --> INVESTIGATION
ENGINE --> INVESTIGATION

%% =========================
%% INVESTIGATION FLOW - PHASE A: ADMIN PORTAL (session metadata, NO logs)
%% =========================
TENANTCTX --> TENANTROUTER
TENANTROUTER --> ADMINPORTAL
ADMINPORTAL --> ADMINSVC
ADMINSVC --> USERTOOL
ADMINSVC --> SESSIONTOOL
ADMINSVC --> FAILTOOL
ADMINSVC --> CASETOOL
ADMINSVC --> ONBOARDTOOL
ADMINSVC --> SUMMARYTOOL

%% =========================
%% INVESTIGATION FLOW - PHASE B: MULTI-TENANT LOG PLATFORM (backend logs)
%% SESSIONTOOL supplies the session time window this phase queries against
%% - this is the corrected dependency (was wrongly ADMINSVC --> LOGTOOL).
%% =========================
TENANTROUTER --> LOKIREG
LOKIREG --> LOKIAPI
SESSIONTOOL -.->|session time window| LOKIAPI
LOKIAPI --> LOGTOOL
LOGTOOL --> LOGEXTRACT

INVESTIGATION --> EVIDENCE
EVIDENCE --> TOOLS
TOOLS -.-> USERTOOL
TOOLS -.-> SESSIONTOOL
TOOLS -.-> FAILTOOL
TOOLS -.-> CASETOOL
TOOLS -.-> ONBOARDTOOL
TOOLS -.-> SUMMARYTOOL
TOOLS -.-> LOGTOOL
TOOLS -.-> VIDEOTOOL
TOOLS -.-> METRICTOOL
TOOLS -.-> SERVERTOOL

LOGEXTRACT --> EVIDENCE
METRICTOOL --> EVIDENCE
SERVERTOOL --> EVIDENCE
EVIDENCE --> ROOTCAUSE

%% =========================
%% KNOWLEDGE ASSISTED REASONING
%% =========================
ROOTCAUSE --> HYBRIDRAG
HYBRIDRAG --> REASONING
REASONING --> LLM

%% =========================
%% GUARDRAILS & OBSERVATION GENERATION (NLG Phase)
%% GUARDRAILS enforces (among other things) that only LOGEXTRACT's redacted
%% output - never LOGTOOL's raw pull - may reach REASONING/OBSGEN. See
%% SUPPORT_OPERATIONS_BLUEPRINT.md §27/§35.
%% =========================
REASONING --> GUARDRAILS
GUARDRAILS --> OBSGEN
ROOTCAUSE --> OBSGEN

%% =========================
%% L1 OBSERVATION → FRESHDESK INTERNAL NOTE
%% L1 pipeline ends here. The note is the L1 deliverable.
%% =========================
OBSGEN --> FDNOTE[Freshdesk Internal Notes]

%% =========================
%% L2 CHECK (does this require Engineering Escalation?)
%% =========================
FDNOTE --> L2CHECK{Needs Engineering?}

%% =========================
%% L2 PATH: ASANA ESCALATION (Wave 8 — Active)
%% =========================
L2CHECK -->|Yes| ASANACREATE[Create Asana Task via AsanaClient]
ASANACREATE --> ASANA
ASANA <--> DEV
ASANACREATE --> FDUPDATE_ESC
FDUPDATE_ESC --> USERRESPONSE[Generate Escalation Reply NLG]
%% Sprint 2.63.1: this send, and the two orchestrator response_draft replies
%% below (Direct Reply Path), are now all gated through ReplySafetyGate
%% (api/routes/webhooks/freshdesk.py::_gated_customer_reply) before reaching
%% FreshdeskResponseService.send_customer_reply().
USERRESPONSE --> FD

%% =========================
%% DIRECT REPLY PATH (no L2 needed)
%% =========================
L2CHECK -->|No| USERRESPONSE
USERRESPONSE --> CLOSECHECK{Resolution Confirmed?}
CLOSECHECK -->|No| CLARIFICATION
CLOSECHECK -->|Yes| CLOSE

%% =========================
%% ASYNC ENGINEERING RESOLUTION — Blueprint §20B (Sprint 2.63, certified;
%% ReplySafetyGate wired Sprint 2.63.1)
%% FIXED is a REAL event: an Asana webhook (task.completed), not polling —
%% see asana/webhook.py + api/routes/webhooks/asana.py. GUARD is
%% ClosureFieldGuard (cf_clients/ticket_type/cf_sop_status/
%% cf_resolution_classification all populated?). GATE is ReplySafetyGate
%% (confidence=1.0 fixed template; kill-switch/duplicate/impact checks still
%% apply). Only if BOTH allow does FDUPDATE send the customer reply +
%% status=4 in one combined PUT and proceed to CLOSE. Either block routes to
%% MANUALNOTE (internal draft note) instead, and the ticket stays open for a
%% human to close.
%% =========================
ASANA --> FIXED[Issue Fixed Event - Asana Webhook]
FIXED --> GUARD{ClosureFieldGuard passes?}
GUARD -->|No| MANUALNOTE[Post Internal Note - Manual Closure Needed]
GUARD -->|Yes| GATE{ReplySafetyGate allows?}
GATE -->|No| MANUALNOTE
GATE -->|Yes| FDUPDATE[Send Customer Resolution Reply + status=4]
FDUPDATE --> CLOSE

%% =========================
%% AUDIT
%% =========================
CASE -.-> AUDIT
ENGINE -.-> AUDIT
INVESTIGATION -.-> AUDIT
ROOTCAUSE -.-> AUDIT
ASANACREATE -.-> AUDIT
USERRESPONSE -.-> AUDIT
CLOSE -.-> AUDIT
AUDIT --> AUDITDB
